stories.title: Central Railway's Top Officials Skip 26/11 Memorial Tribute In Mumbai, Attend Constitution Day Events
stories.summary: Mumbai: On the 18th anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, Central Railway’s two senior-most officials in Mumbai skipped the memorial tribute at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), even as security personnel, railway union representatives and passengers gathered to honour the victims.

stories.title: Sharad Pawar admitted to Mumbai's Breach Candy Hospital, says Supriya Sule
stories.summary: Nationalist Congress Party (Sharadchandra Pawar) chief Sharad Pawar was admitted to Breach Candy Hospital in south Mumbai on Thursday, with his condition appearing to be related to dehydration, his daughter and party MP Supriya Sule said. Sule shared the information about her father's hospitalisation and said he needed to reduce his workload and limit frequent travel.

stories.title: Mumbai Mayor's office, Amitabh Bachchan's bungalow Jalsa get bomb threat
stories.summary: Mumbai was placed on high alert on Thursday after a threatening email sent to Mayor Ritu Tawde and Municipal Commissioner Ashwini Bhide warned of possible bomb blasts at several locations in the city. This is not the first time Amitabh Bachchan's residence has figured in a bomb threat.

stories.title: Mumbai Bomb Threat: Mayor Ritu Tawde, Civic Chief Ashwini Bhide, Amitabh Bachchan’s Jalsa And Diljit Dosanjh Concert Targeted In Fresh Email
stories.summary: The email, received at around 10 am, was written in Punjabi, Hindi and English. 11 pm on November 26 and a court at 3 pm the same day. The threat also mentioned an alleged drone attack on Amitabh Bachchan’s residence, Jalsa, between November 27 and December 31. Singer Diljit Dosanjh, who is scheduled to perform at Mumbai’s Mahalaxmi Racecourse on Friday, November 27, was also specifically named in the email.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai: NMMC Announces 12-Hour Water Cut On November 27 For Maintenance And Flow Meter Installation; Check Affected Areas
stories.summary: @NMMConline Navi Mumbai, November 26, 2026: Residents across Navi Mumbai, including Kharghar and Kamothe, are likely to face inconvenience as the Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation (NMMC) has announced a 12-hour water supply shutdown on Friday, November 27, for maintenance and installation work on its main water distribution network.

stories.title: Why CJP's Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka Are Facing Look Out Circulars
stories.summary: Mumbai, November 26, 2026: Mumbai Police has issued Lookout Circulars (LoCs) against Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke and co-convenors Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das in connection with an FIR registered over the party's allegedly unauthorised protest at Shivaji Park in Dadar on October 2, coinciding with Gandhi Jayanti.

stories.title: Bombay HC: Tree plantation cannot be a paperwork formality
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court has stressed that Maharashtra government agencies must undertake genuine afforestation efforts before seeking permission to clear green cover for infrastructure projects, warning that tree plantation cannot be treated as a mere paperwork formality. 2869 hectares of mangrove forest land for a transport project in Mumbai.

stories.title: 18 years later, 6 key conspirators of 26/11 attacks operate freely in Pakistan
stories.summary: Six key conspirators of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, including Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) chief Hafiz Saeed and the outfit’s operations chief, Zaki-Ur-Rehman Lakhvi, operate freely in Pakistan and run their terror networks without facing any significant legal consequences.

stories.title: Mumbai's BEST plans 10,000-bus fleet; here's what 2027-28 budget proposes
stories.summary: 89 crore for the financial year 2027-28, with a focus on expanding bus services, modernising its fleet and improving financial performance. The budget estimates, approved by the BEST Committee, were presented by General Manager Dr Sonia Sethi before the Standing Committee on November 26, 2026.

stories.title: Pune court attack: Five arrested, minor detained over attack on murder accused
stories.summary: Five people were arrested while a minor was detained in connection with the attack on a murder accused outside Pune’s Shivajinagar district and sessions court on Wednesday afternoon. The prime accused, Akshay Subhash Chavan (20), is the brother of a man who was murdered earlier in a case in which the victim of Wednesday’s attack, Mandar Kiwale, is an accused, police said.

stories.title: 18 years after 26/11 attacks, survivor Devika Rotawan looks for a fresh start
stories.summary: The terror attack survivor who identified Ajmal Kasab in court is now looking for a job, hoping to work with children and contribute to society. Eighteen years after the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks , Devika Natwarlal Rotawan — who became a symbol of courage after identifying terrorist Ajmal Kasab in court as a nine-year-old — is looking for a new beginning in her professional life.

stories.title: ‘It could be my last day’: Railway announcer recalls horror at Mumbai's CST station during 26/11 terror attacks
stories.summary: Eleven years after joining the Railways as a bungalow peon, Bablu Kumar Deepak found himself behind a microphone at Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus on 26/11, where a last-minute shift change placed him at the centre of one of India's deadliest terror attacks and turned his voice into a lifeline for hundreds of trapped commuters.

stories.title: Mumbai man abuses, assaults police constable over loud music complaint; arrested
stories.summary: According to the FIR, Vadgar rang the doorbell two to three times, but received no response. Finding the door unlocked, he entered the house and knocked on the door of the room from where loud music was playing. Jha allegedly confronted him and refused to lower the volume despite repeated requests.

stories.title: Ravi Kishan recalls father thrashing him for wearing saree for Ramleela, says he wanted to ‘kill him’ for pursuing acting
stories.summary: Ravi Kishan has spent more than three decades in the film industry, but his popularity has found a new audience in recent years. The actor's memes and viral moments have made him a favourite among Gen Z, bringing him renewed attention on social media.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai Orchestra Licence Plea: Bombay HC Directs Maharashtra Govt To Decide Representation Within 8 Weeks
stories.summary: A bench of Chief Justice MC Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna passed the order on November 25 while hearing a petition filed by the association, which had challenged the premature cancellation of orchestra licences held by some of its members. The association told the court that several hotels and restaurants had valid orchestra licences until December 31, 2026.

stories.title: Bomb Threat Email Triggers Evacuation At Thane Civic Headquarters, No Suspicious Objects Found
stories.summary: Thane, November 26, 2026: Authorities evacuated the Thane Municipal Corporation (TMC) headquarters on Thursday afternoon after receiving an email threatening to blow up the building with a bomb. Following thorough checks by security agencies, the threat was confirmed to be a hoax, with no explosive or suspicious items recovered.

stories.title: Mumbai pauses to remember 26/11 on 18th anniversary as leaders pay floral tributes to bravehearts
stories.summary: Mumbai, Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma and Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Thursday paid floral tributes at the city police headquarters to those who made the ultimate sacrifice while fighting terrorists during the Mumbai terror attacks 18 years ago. Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar, Director General of Police Sadanand Date, Mumbai Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and other officials were present on the occasion.

stories.title: Hoax Bomb Threat Emails Trigger Panic Across Navi Mumbai, Police Find No Explosives
stories.summary: Navi Mumbai: On Thursday, coinciding with Constitution Day and the anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, Navi Mumbai witnessed a series of hoax bomb threats sent through emails to multiple locations, including the Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation (NMMC) headquarters, CBD Belapur court and NMMC hospitals in Nerul and Vashi.

stories.title: Mumbai to Get New Depot for Vande Bharat and Long-Distance Trains At Currey Road
stories.summary: Western Railway (WR) is planning to build a new INR 98-crore coaching depot at Currey Road to deal with the pressure on Mumbai Central and Dadar . It will cover about 55,000 square metres and have 10 dedicated railway lines for maintaining, inspecting, repairing and parking long-distance trains.

stories.title: Bomb threat email warns of attacks at Mumbai Mayor`s office, metro stations and music concert; no suspicious objects found
stories.summary: Mumbai Police received an email on Thursday threatening bomb blasts , grenade attacks and the planting of improvised explosive devices (IEDs) at the Mayor's office, metro rail stations and a concert involving actor-singer Diljit Dosanjh, reported the PTI. The threat was received on November 26, the 18th anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks.

stories.title: 26/11 Mumbai attack: Who were Ajmal Kasab’s lawyers? How much remuneration was to be paid to them, and on what basis?
stories.summary: Nearly 18 years after the 26/11 Mumbai attacks, advocates Amin Solkar and Farhana Shah, who were assigned to represent the sole captured attacker Ajmal Kasab, are yet to receive their fees for handling the case, according to PTI . The two lawyers appeared on Kasab's behalf before the Bombay High Court for nine months after the Maharashtra government appointed them in June 2010.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai airport crosses 4 million passengers ahead of first anniversary
stories.summary: The Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) has handled more than 4 million passengers in less than 11 months of commercial operations, crossing the milestone a month ahead of its first anniversary on December 25. While domestic traffic has driven the initial growth, new international routes and the proposed transfer of flights from Mumbai airport are expected to significantly expand its overseas operations.

stories.title: CBI searches six premises in ₹80-cr housing finance fraud case
stories.summary: 15-crore bank fraud involving Mumbai-based Star Housing Finance Ltd. The company is accused of siphoning off loan funds from public-sector lender National Housing Bank (NHB) through fictitious loan disbursements. The searches at premises linked to the company’s directors and other individuals led to the recovery of documents and records relevant to the investigation.

stories.title: BMC conducts demolitions in Andheri as part of SV Road widening project
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Thursday said that it has cleared seven structures obstructing a key road connecting Bharadawadi Road with Swami Vivekanand Road (SV Road) in Andheri West. According to an official statement, the action was carried out on November 25 as part of the first phase of the SV Road widening project being undertaken by the civic body's K West ward.

stories.title: Mumbai Food Safety Crackdown: FDA Suspends Licences Of Zepto, BigBasket Units & 9 Others
stories.summary: Mumbai: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the food licences and registration certificates of 11 establishments, including Zepto's dark store in Sakinaka, BigBasket's warehouse in Nerul and Royal Punjab Restaurant and Bar in Kanjurmarg, over serious food safety violations.

stories.title: Walmart-owned Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down
stories.summary: Walmart-owned Flipkart on Wednesday announced that chief executive officer Kalyan Krishnamurthy would conclude his tenure after more than 11 years with the company, marking the end of a leadership stint during which the e-commerce business grew more than fivefold.

stories.title: Mumbai: BMC Approves Raymond Ltd As Operator For 15-Year Worli Jetty Helipad Project
stories.summary: Mumbai, November 26, 2026: Mumbai’s Worli jetty, located opposite Worli Dairy and extending 120 metres into the Arabian Sea, is set to get a new identity as a Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)-licensed helipad. The BMC Standing Committee has approved Raymond Ltd.

stories.title: Thane Civic Headquarters Receives Bomb Threat Email Hours After Similar Scare At BMC
stories.summary: A bomb threat email targeting the Thane Municipal Corporation headquarters on Thursday triggered panic on the premises. Following the threat, the entire building was evacuated as a security precaution. Police personnel and disaster management teams launched a search operation. Similar Threat At BMC Earlier in the day, Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde and Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) Commissioner Ashwini Bhide also received a bomb threat email.

stories.title: On 26/11 anniversary, email warns of blast at Mumbai mayor's office, metro stations and Diljit Dosanjh event
stories.summary: Mumbai received a chilling email warning of grenade attacks targeting the Mayor's Office and metro stations over the next month, signed by someone claiming to be Hannah Meler. The correspondence cited historical violence linked to Khalistani movements, including the infamous 1984 anti-Sikh riots. Officials found no grounds for concern after searches but are pursuing legal action regarding this serious threat.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu introduces 15 days of paternity leave for married government employees
stories.summary: In a significant move, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has announced 15 days of paternity leave for married male employees of the State government. According to an official release issued on Thursday (November 26, 2026), the paternity leave can be availed by male employees either 15 days before the birth of the child or within six months from the date of birth.

stories.title: Eighteen years after 26/11, Ajmal Kasab's lawyers still await fees
stories.summary: Eighteen years after the 26/11 terror attacks, two lawyers who set aside their other cases to represent the lone captured Pakistani terrorist Ajmal Kasab continue to await their remuneration. Amin Solkar and Farhana Shah represented Kasab before the Bombay High Court for nine months following their appointment by the Maharashtra government in 2010.

stories.title: Tata Trusts decides to move Bombay High Court challenging N. Chandrasekaran’s reappointment
stories.summary: Tata ​Trusts, ‌which owns a 66% holding in Tata Sons, the holding company of the Tata Group, has decided to move to the ‌Bombay ⁠High Court to challenge the reappointment of N. ​Chandrasekaran as ‌chairman of Tata Sons. On September 17, 2026, the Tata Sons board approved his third term beginning in February 2027 by a majority vote.

stories.summary: K. K. government figures released on Thursday (November 26, 2026). K. K. minus those emigrating, fell dramatically from 2,04,000 for the year ending June 2025 and from a record high of 9,00,000 in the year ending June 2023. The news is likely to a shot in the arm for the governing Labour Party, as migration has become a political lighting-rod in recent years.

stories.title: Tata Trusts move Bombay HC against Tata Sons, challenge Chandrasekaran’s second term as executive chairman; seek Rs 65 crore damages and ask court to bar chairman from using casting vote in case of disagreement
stories.summary: D. Tata Trust (RDTT) on Thursday moved the Bombay high court against Tata Sons and six of its directors, essentially to seek that the Tata Sons’ chairman cannot have the casting vote rights when there is a disagreement between the two Trust nominated directors in the forthcoming board meeting on November 30 and have challenged the September 17 resolution for reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman for a second five-year term.

stories.title: Twinkle Khanna roasts husband Akshay Kumar for singing bhajans at 6 am, doing Koffee With Karan season 9 for free
stories.summary: Bollywood actor Akshay Kumar recently appeared on Koffee With Karan 9 alongside Ravi Kishan . During a fun segment on the show, the actor called his wife, Twinkle Khanna , only to find himself at the receiving end of her witty remarks. The hilarious exchange has since caught the internet's attention, with social media users having a field day over Twinkle's roast.

stories.title: ‘Focus on action rather than words’, says Kharge on Imran Masood. Congress MP responds
stories.summary: Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge on Thursday said he often hears party MP Imran Masood speak passionately on television, but stressed that the focus should be on “action rather than just words”. Responding to him, Masood said that Kharge's remarks on arrogance were justified and must be accepted.

stories.title: 'Abdul Will Become Deputy Chief Minister': Chandrashekhar Azad's Big Muslim Outreach Ahead Of 2027 UP Polls
stories.summary: Lucknow: On the occasion of Constitution Day, Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) president and Nagina MP Chandrashekhar Azad on Thursday said that if the 'Samajik Parivartan Morcha' forms the next Uttar Pradesh government after the 2027 Assembly elections, leaders from the Muslim community and backward communities will be Deputy Chief Ministers.

stories.title: Govt calls for special Parliament session from Monday amid delimitation bill buzz
stories.summary: The government has proposed special Parliament sitting, with the Lok Sabha reconvening on November 30 and the Rajya Sabha on December 2. "The Government has requested Hon’ble Speaker, Lok Sabha and Hon’ble Chairman, Rajya Sabha to reconvene Lok Sabha on Monday, 30th November, 2026 and Rajya Sabha on Wednesday, 2nd December, 2026 respectively to transact essential Government Business and subject to exigencies of the Business.

stories.title: Aryan's rumoured girlfriend Larissa says the Khans are like family to her: 'SRK is the King'
stories.summary: Brazilian model and actress Larissa Bonesi has described the Khan family as her own, speaking about her bond with actor Shah Rukh Khan and his son, filmmaker Aryan Khan. Larissa and Aryan are often spotted together, which lead to the speculation that they are in a relationship.

stories.title: Look Out Circular Issued Against CJP's Saurav Das At Request Of Maharashtra Police, Centre Tells Delhi HC
stories.summary: Das had on Monday approached the court challenging the authorities' decision to prevent him from travelling to the United Kingdom. Additional Solicitor General Chetan Sharma, representing the Centre, told Justice Amit Mahajan that the circular had been issued on November 22 and 23, the Hindustan Times reported.

stories.title: Brad Pitt, Angelina Jolie settle years-long legal battle over French winery Château Miraval
stories.summary: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie have settled a bitter legal fight over the sale of a French winery they bought together, the former couple said Wednesday. In a terse statement provided to US media, the Hollywood stars gave no details about the agreement for Chateau Miraval, the upscale estate whose ownership became entangled in a vicious divorce.

stories.title: Supreme Court to hear contempt pleas in Thirupparankundram lamp-lighting row on Nov. 27
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday (November 26, 2026) informed that an application to shift the Karthigai Deepam flame burning at the Deepa Mandapam to the Deepathoon located atop the Thirupparankundram Hill and contempt petitions filed against Tamil Nadu authorities for failing to comply with a November 20 order to light the sacred lamp on the stone pillar will be listed on November 27.

stories.title: Special Parliament sitting from November 30 likely to take up amended Delimitation Bill
stories.summary: The government has called for a special sitting of Parliament beginning Monday (November 30, 2026), where it is likely to table an amended Delimitation Bill. The two Houses will meet on separate dates, Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju announced on Thursday (November 26, 2026), which is the 104th day since the Monsoon Session adjourned indefinitely on August 13.

stories.title: Vande Mataram rendition at J&K Waqf event sparks row | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: The playing of the national song, Vande Mataram, at the Waqf Day ceremony in Srinagar on Monday has triggered a controversy, with several clerics expressed repentance for attending the event organised by the J&K Waqf Board. Mirwaiz Umar Farooq-led Mutahida Majlis-e-Ulama (MMU) on Wednesday and condemned the ‘growing imposition’ of the song in J&K, saying its lyrics were against Islamic religious beliefs.

stories.title: Netflix documentary Love Scam Aur Dhokha to explore Sukesh Chandrashekhar's Bollywood links, alleged multi-crore fraud
stories.summary: Conman Sukesh Chandrashekhar ’s alleged multi-crore fraud and his glittering Bollywood connections are soon set to be the subject of a true-crime documentary titled Love Scam Aur Dhokha: The Sukesh Chandrashekhar Story. The documentary will stream on Netflix , the streamer announced on Thursday.

stories.title: Bombay HC extends stay on demolition of building linked to Dawood Ibrahim
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court on Wednesday extended its stay on the demolition of a dilapidated South Mumbai building where fugitive gangster Dawood Ibrahim and his family once lived. It also prohibited anyone from entering the premises. A bench of Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna continued its stay on the demolition of the two-storey Haji Ismail Haji Habib Musafirkhana on Pakmodia Street till November 30.

stories.title: 16-yr-old dies at construction site in Kottayam after scaffolding collapses
stories.summary: A 16-year-old migrant worker from West Bengal died and two others, also from the same State, were injured after a scaffolding collapsed during construction work on a house near Erattupetta here on Thursday,the police said. The incident occurred in the afternoon when a part of the scaffolding on which they were standing collapsed and also took down a nearby concrete pole carrying power lines, police said.

stories.title: Supreme Court quashes Bihar govt's remission for ex-MP Anand Mohan in IAS officer lynching case
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday set aside the Bihar government decision to grant remission to former MP Anand Mohan in the 1994 lynching of district magistrate G Krishnaiah. A bench of justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu directed the former lawmaker, who was released in 2023, to surrender within a month.

stories.title: Congress Takes Meta To Court Over Alleged Restrictions On Its Accounts
stories.summary: Meta officials on Tuesday met Congress leaders in Delhi and raised concerns about its employees and offices being targeted across India, people aware of the matter said. The meeting follows nearly a week of protests by the Congress’s youth wing — Indian Youth Congress (IYC) — outside the company’s offices over allegations of restrictions on accounts and posts of their leaders critical of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

stories.title: Hisense E7S Hi-QLED MiniLED TV Series Launched in India With VRR and Dolby Atmos Support: Price, Specifications
stories.summary: Hisense has launched E7S Hi-QLED MiniLED TV series in India, comprising of 55-inch and 65-inch screen sizes TV. The new series combines Full Array Local Dimming technology, a Super Bright Panel, Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, and Google TV to deliver an enhanced viewing and audio experience.

stories.title: Aaradhya Bachchan channels Disney princess as she poses with Aishwarya Rai, aunt Shrima Rai in unseen pic from birthday bash
stories.summary: Bollywood actor Aishwarya Rai 's family moments often draw attention, and a recent picture shared by her sister-in-law Shrima Rai has offered a glimpse into one such celebration. The photo features Aishwarya, her daughter Aaradhya Bachchan and her mother, Vrinda Rai, posing together with the family during a birthday celebration.

stories.title: Uttarakhand: Pawani fire leaves 45 families homeless, destroys winter stocks; CM announces ₹5 lakh aid
stories.summary: For generations, families in Uttarkashi’s remote Pawani village have spent weeks stocking up on foodgrains, firewood and fodder before winter, knowing that heavy snowfall can cut them off from the rest of the world for months. But a massive fire on November 24 destroyed more than 45 homes and wiped out those carefully built reserves, leaving residents facing the freezing months ahead with almost nothing.

stories.title: Ahmedabad: 5-Year-Old Girl Killed After Truck Hits Bike On Way To School
stories.summary: Harshitkumar Patel, 38, who lives in New Ranip, left home at around 7:45 am on his motorcycle with his daughter, Mrisha, riding pillion. The accident occurred at approximately 8 am while they were on their way to Nutan School in the Ghatlodia area. According to the police, Patel was crossing the Chandlodia railway bridge near Durga School when the truck suddenly swerved to the right.

stories.title: Maharashtra: 36-Year-Old Welding Shop Owner Dies After Iron Drum Explodes While Cutting It With Machine In Gondia; CCTV VIDEO Surfaces
stories.summary: According to reports, the incident occurred on Wednesday, November 25. The deceased has been identified as Yogesh Rahangdale, a resident of Shivnagar in Chhota Gondia. The report further stated that Yogesh was cutting an iron drum with a cutting machine at his shop when a spark from the cutter apparently came into contact with the residual gas inside the drum, triggering a massive explosion.

stories.title: Monkey Menace At Taj Mahal: Tourists Face Safety Concerns As Troops Of Monkeys Take Over Monument - WATCH
stories.summary: The Taj Mahal, a major tourist attraction in Agra and one of India's most recognised heritage landmarks, is facing growing concerns over the presence of large groups of monkeys across its premises. Videos showing troops of monkeys roaming around the monument have surfaced on social media, raising questions about visitor safety, particularly for foreign tourists.

stories.title: Accredited vs self-proclaimed: SC to examine protection for journalists
stories.summary: The petitions were filed by the Kerala Union of Working Journalists (KUWJ) and the Delhi Union of Journalists over alleged police action against media personnel covering protests on October 10 and 11, 2026. stories.title: Manoj Bajpayee recalls 1st meeting with Naseeruddin Shah: 'He would have really hit me that day'
stories.summary: Manoj Bajpayee has shared the story of an unforgettable first meeting with Naseeruddin Shah at the wrap party of 'Bandit Queen'. By his own account, it came close to turning violent. Manoj Bajpayee recalls about a wrap party that nearly went wrongIn a chat with The HFF News, Manoj Bajpayee looked back on the evening in Delhi when Shekhar Kapur introduced him to Naseeruddin Shah.

stories.title: Yash Maheshwari Chhath Puja Remarks Row: Giriraj Singh, Other BJP Leaders Seek Strict Action Against Comedian
stories.summary: New Delhi [India], November 26: Union Minister Giriraj Singh and several senior Bihar Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leaders have strongly condemned stand-up comedian Yash Maheshwari over his alleged derogatory remarks about the Chhath festival and Bihari women, with several leaders demanding his immediate arrest and strict legal action.

stories.title: Maharashtra Cabinet approves free foodgrains for over 42 lakh farmers
stories.summary: 30 lakh farmers not covered under Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), a ₹5,548-crore provision for the Narmada-Tapi diversion project in Nandurbar, confiscation of assets of firms involved in financial fraud, and a law to regulate private-aided schools, among 14 decisions.

stories.title: Two dead after Iranian drone attack on Kuwait
stories.summary: Kuwait’s army says two Italian workers were killed and four others were injured after Iranian drones targeted a “vital site”. Kuwaiti forces intercepted several other drones during the attack. Al Jazeera’s Zein Basravi has the latest.

stories.title: Hamas political official and wife among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
stories.summary: A Hamas political official and his wife were among eight Palestinians killed in three Israeli air strikes across the Gaza Strip on Thursday. Local sources told the BBC a residential apartment in Deir al-Balah was targeted at dawn, killing Khaled Abu Nada - the deputy education minister - and his wife, Abeer Mohammed Ismail Abu Nada.

stories.title: Fuel tanker crash ignites massive fire on highway surrounding Cairo, killing at least 31 people
stories.summary: A crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a massive fire on a major highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), killing at least 31 people, Egyptian authorities said. The blaze on Ring Road, a key artery that encircles the Egyptian capital, also injured at least 25 people and left more than two dozen cars and motorcycles charred, the Public Prosecutor's office said in a statement.

stories.title: Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65
stories.summary: Music correspondent Published 25 November 2026 Updated 21 minutes ago Simon Le Bon, Sir Rod Stewart and Gary Kemp are among the pop stars who have paid tribute to Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor following his death at the age of 65. Taylor co-wrote some of the group's biggest hits including Save A Prayer, Rio and Girls On Film.

stories.title: Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Nitesh Tiwari and Namit Malhotra meet Amit Shah as Ramayana nears ₹1,800 crore worldwide
stories.summary: Ranbir Kapoor , Yash and Sai Pallavi-starrer Ramayana has had a strong run at the box office since its release on November 5. Following the film’s phenomenal success, its lead actors Ranbir and Sai, producer Namit Malhotra, co-producer Niraj Sanghai and director Nitesh Tiwari recently met Union Home Minister Amit Shah during their visit to Delhi.

stories.title: US Marlboro maker Altria explores Imperial Brands takeover in Big Tobacco mega deal
stories.summary: US-based Altria is considering a possible bid for Imperial, it said in a statement Thursday. Japan Tobacco has been studying teaming up with Altria on a deal for the British company, people with knowledge of the matter said, asking not to be identified because the information is private.

stories.title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving parade due to severe weather
stories.summary: Macy's has postponed its 100th annual Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York to Saturday because of severe weather. Preparations to hold the iconic holiday celebration, known for its massive balloons that float among the city's skyscrapers, had already begun when the forecast for heavy rain and strong winds on Thursday led to the delay.

stories.title: Plane crash off coast of Mississippi kills extended family of six on fishing trip
stories.summary: Authorities are investigating why a small plane carrying six members of a Florida family crashed off the Mississippi coast on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). They were returning home from a fishing trip, relatives say. The plane’s pilot was Brent Stokes, the 50-year-old president of a marine contracting company based in Fort Myers, according to Jackson County Coroner Bruce Lynd Jr.

stories.title: From Beef Nihari To Lamb Korma: Pakistan's First Astronaut Gets A Special Halal Menu In Space
stories.summary: Life aboard a space station comes with its share of unusual experiences, but for Pakistan’s first astronaut, Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, there is also a comforting taste of home waiting hundreds of kilometres above Earth. Butter chicken, beef nihari, lamb korma and curried chickpeas (chole) are among the Pakistani-style dishes specially prepared for him during his stay aboard China’s Tiangong space station.

stories.title: Myanmar refuses to comply with parts of ICJ genocide ruling
stories.summary: Myanmar will not comply with "inappropriate" parts of the genocide ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ), its leader Min Aung Hlaing has said in his first public comments since the court decision. The ICJ's landmark ruling last week found Myanmar guilty of committing genocide against its Rohingya minority in a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands and forced more than 700,000 to flee.

stories.title: Huntingdon train attacker found guilty of all 14 counts of attempted murder

Fact: Almost all cervical cancers are caused by persistent infection with high-risk Human Papillomavirus (HPV), rather than inherited genetic mutations. Fact: HPV vaccination is most effective before exposure to the virus.

stories.title: Nurse recalls delivering ‘Bullet Girl’ at Cama Hospital amid 26/11 gunfire
stories.summary: The night of November 26, 2008 remains etched in the memory of Mumbai as one of its darkest hours. Gunshots rang through the city, terror gripped its streets, and Cama and Albless Hospital, one of the places targeted by terrorists, became a site of unimaginable horror. Yet, amid the sound of bullets, grenades and the chaos unfolding within its walls, a child was born.

stories.title: Knee surgery rules Sinner out of Australian Open

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Azharuddeen’s century powers Kerala into the Super League
stories.summary: Mohammed Azharuddeen’s signature rocking-the-bat celebration has become a defining moment in this season’s Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy T20 cricket tournament. The opening batter brought it out once again on Friday for his second T20 hundred (101, 57b, 8x4, 6x6) which dismantled Himachal Pradesh and helped Kerala register a 67-run win to qualify for the Super League.

stories.title: Former England scrum-half and commentator Starmer-Smith dies aged 81
stories.summary: Former England scrum-half and rugby union commentator Nigel Starmer-Smith has died aged 81. Starmer-Smith represented Harlequins and the Barbarians, and made seven appearances for England between 1969-71. After his retirement in 1976, Starmer-Smith moved into broadcasting and journalism. He voiced the BBC's highlights programme Rugby Special for 15 years and commentated for ITV at the 2003 World Cup in Australia, won by England.

stories.title: Glenn makes 'free ball' history in WBBL after Dottin timed out

stories.summary: India A’s Abhishek Sharma scored a half-century against Sri Lanka A in the Asia Cup Rising Stars semifinal in Doha on Thursday. The Punjab opener’s knock, comprising nine fours, put India in a position of command in the semifinal. Abhishek first combined with Vaibhav Sooryvanshi in the Powerplay to keep the scoreboard ticking with regular boundaries.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo deserves to leave on his own terms: Pep Guardiola urges Portugal to arrange farewell

stories.title: SMAT: UP thrashed by Bengal
stories.summary: Former champions Uttar Pradesh edged closer to elimination in the T20 Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy after Bengal inflicted a 93-run defeat in them in Mumbai on Tuesday. Bengal dismantled them, posting 201/3 in 15 overs and then restricting UP to 108/7. The match aggregate of just 309 runs was the lowest in a T20 involving Bengal and Uttar Pradesh, but Bengal owned the contest from the start.

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. These include reducing the waiting period for final PF settlement after unemployment from 12 months to two months, lowering the minimum balance that members must retain in their accounts from 25% to 10%, and introducing a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP).

stories.title: Maharashtra's new property card plan: What flat owners, homebuyers need to know
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has proposed issuing separate property cards for individual flats in buildings, recording ownership details, sanctioned area, associated rights, mortgages and other liabilities. The proposed system, called the Vertical Property Card, aims to create an independent supplementary record of rights for every eligible flat or unit, alongside existing land records.
